keyword.zh: 品锦混凝土泵上的S阀名称没有写明什么

title.en: What an S-Valve Name Does Not Specify
title.zh: S阀这个名称没有写明什么

description.en: The Xingtai parts list names S-valve pistons and an S-tube. It does not print swing angle, bore or a service sequence.
description.zh: 邢台配件清单写出S阀活塞和S管。它没有印摆角、缸径或保养顺序。

h1.en: What an S-Valve Name Does Not Specify
h1.zh: S阀这个名称没有写明什么

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery uses the words S-valve and S-tube for concrete pump wear parts made in Xingtai. The parts category calls them S-valve wear parts. The split-piston line says the set is for S-valve concrete pumps, and a separate line names an S-tube seal. Those names mark a circuit. They do not print a swing angle, a bore, a stroke or a replacement sequence.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械用 S阀 和 S管 来称呼在邢台生产的混凝土泵易损件。配件分类称之为 S阀易损件。分体活塞一行写明用于 S阀混凝土泵，另一行写出 S管密封。这些名称标出一条回路。它们没有印摆角、缸径、行程或更换顺序。泵的产量、压力和距离仍要回参数页去读。

body.en: They appear on the concrete pump parts category and on the named wear-part pages, not as a timed diagram on Electric 20 or Diesel 40. A hopper on a pump sheet is still a hopper cell. An S-tube seal name does not add a hopper volume.
body.zh: 它们出现在混凝土泵配件分类和点名的易损件页面上，不是电动20或柴油40上的节拍图。泵页上的料斗仍然只是料斗格。S管密封这个名称不会多出一个料斗容积。

body.en: The catalogue also names a main-cylinder seal, a swing-cylinder seal and a swing-arm ball. Together they are the published vocabulary. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not print the degrees of swing or the order of movement.
body.zh: 目录还写出主油缸密封、摆缸密封和摆臂球头。合在一起，这是已公布的用词。河北品锦机械没有印摆动角度或动作顺序。

heading.en: What you still read on the pump

body.en: Power, theoretical output, pressure where printed, and the distance label on that concrete pump remain the performance cells. The S-valve name does not replace them. For a size the parts page does not need this article to repeat, open the part page itself or /en/contact/.
body.zh: 动力、理论输送量、印出了的压力，以及这台混凝土泵上的距离标题，仍然是性能格。S阀名称不能代替它们。配件页上的尺寸不必在本文重复，请打开配件页或 /zh/contact/。

question.en: Does the pump sheet draw an S-valve cycle?
question.zh: 泵的参数页画了S阀循环吗？

answer.en: No. The cycle timing is not printed. The name is on the parts list.
answer.zh: 没有。循环节拍没有印出。名称在配件清单上。

question.en: Is a gate-valve model listed as a pump code?
question.zh: 有没有闸阀型号被列成泵的代号？

answer.en: The concrete pump rows do not print a gate-valve model code. The wear-part wording that is printed says S-valve.
answer.zh: 混凝土泵各行没有印闸阀型号代号。印出的易损件用词是 S阀。

question.en: Does the S-tube name include a bore?

answer.en: No. Bore is not printed on the pump sheets or as part of that name.
answer.zh: 不包含。泵的参数页没有印缸径，名称里也没有。

question.en: Where is the S-valve wording published?

answer.en: On the concrete pump parts category and the piston and S-tube pages of Hebei Pinjin Machinery.
answer.zh: 在河北品锦机械的混凝土泵配件分类，以及活塞和 S管页面上。
